verdict.rationale: Fellow documents webhooks that POST event notifications, such as an AI note being generated or an action item being completed, to an integrator's URL. The integrator must supply the receiving endpoint and all action logic, so webhooks are a developer building block rather than in-product trigger-action rules. The evidence explicitly states that no in-product rules engine is documented and that the help center has no automation, rule or trigger articles.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
